"Game pertarungan 1 lawan 1 gaya fighting side-scroller, terinspirasi dari Naruto Senki, seluruh karakter dan musuh berasal dari serial anime Chainsaw Man.
Grafis retro 8-bit pixel art, semua animasi karakter dibuat menggunakan sprite sheet yang rapi.
Mode permainan: 1 VS 1 player vs player / player vs AI.

Daftar karakter yang tersedia:
Denji (Chainsaw Man), Power, Aki Hayakawa, Makima, Kobeni, Himeno, Beam, Reze, Katana Man, Quanxi

Setiap karakter punya:
✅ Sprite sheet gerakan: diam, jalan, lari, melompat, pukulan biasa, serangan khusus, skill ultimate, kena serangan, knock down, kalah
✅ Sound effect 8-bit untuk setiap serangan
✅ Latar arena pertarungan: jalanan kota Tokyo, gedung rusak, kantor Public Safety, hutan

Kontrol: tombol arah untuk gerak, tombol serangan, tombol lompat, tombol skill, tombol ultimate
UI 8-bit sederhana: bar HP dua sisi, nama karakter, timer pertarungan, teks \"FIGHT!\" dan \"KO!\"

Tidak ada elemen karakter Naruto sama sekali, semuanya Chainsaw Man.
Warna cerah tapi tetap nuansa gelap khas Chainsaw Man, efek partikel pixel saat serangan mendarat.
Sprite sheet 8-bit pixel art karakter Chainsaw Man, latar belakang transparan, susunan frame animasi rapi, ukuran sprite seragam, kualitas bersih tanpa cacat.
Frame: idle, walk, run, jump, punch, kick, special attack, ultimate, hurt, knock down, victory pose
Pertarungan cepat dan dinamis, combo ringan seperti Naruto Senki, tidak terlalu rumit.
AI lawan memiliki tingkat kesulitan mudah, sedang, dan sulit.
Layar hasil akhir menampilkan pemenang dengan pose kemenangan karakter masing-masing.
Jangan pakai karakter Naruto, Jangan grafis 3D, Jangan gambar realistis, Jangan resolusi terlalu tinggi, Jangan animasi berantakan, Jangan latar tidak transparan untuk sprite sheet

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 1v1 Chainsaw Man-themed retro pixel-art fighting game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Include Denji, Power, Aki Hayakawa, Makima, Kobeni, Himeno, Beam, Reze, Katana Man, and Quanxi.
- Support player-vs-player and player-vs-AI with easy, normal, and hard AI.
- Include movement, attacks, jump, skill, ultimate, arena selection, health bars, timer, fight/KO messaging, hit particles, sound effects, and winner screen.
- Keep the presentation 8-bit/pixel-art; no Naruto characters, 3D graphics, or realistic art.

## Decisions
- Built as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript canvas game with procedurally drawn pixel-art characters and synthesized square-wave sound effects.
- Implemented local two-player controls as WASD/J/K/L versus arrow keys/Numpad1/2/3.
- Added four selectable arenas and generated fighter sprites instead of external sprite assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the roster/menu UI, fighter selection, arenas, canvas combat, AI difficulty, local multiplayer, touch controls, audio toggle, pause, and result/rematch screens.
- Verified `node --check game.js` and browser gameplay; latest browser console check reported no errors.
- Saved browser screenshots at `screenshots/home.jpg`, `screenshots/game.jpg`, and `screenshots/playing.jpg`.

### Active
- No active work was underway.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If continuing, inspect `game.js` for gameplay polish and verify controls/combat behavior beyond the initial browser smoke test.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens, HUD, controls, roster UI, and overlays.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual styling.
- `game.js`: Fighter roster, procedural pixel rendering, combat logic, AI, controls, sound, and UI behavior.
- `screenshots/playing.jpg`: Latest gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push was made.
- The initial browser check exposed and then fixed `ReferenceError: $ is not defined` in `aiInput`; latest console check is clean.
